title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the Main South neighborhood and surrounding Worcester corridors within walking distance of Clark University's campus.

cards.title: Main Street
cards.subtitle: Main South Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this local diner for Salvadoran-inspired brunch and pupusas in the historic space formerly known as Annie's.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood diner on Main Street serving a blend of American breakfast and Salvadoran specialties.
cards.evidence_claim: Belén’s Clark Brunch opened at 934 Main St., taking over the longtime home of Annie’s Clark Brunch near Clark University.
cards.source_title: New diner opens in longtime Annie's Clark Brunch location on Main Street
cards.access_notes: Open for breakfast and lunch; check current hours for specific brunch service times.

cards.title: Main Street
cards.subtitle: Main South Corridor
cards.notes: Walk across the street to 'Crystal Park' to enjoy the walking trails, basketball courts, and views of Crystal Pond.
cards.short_summary: A 14.3-acre public park directly adjacent to campus featuring recreational facilities and a historic pond.
cards.evidence_claim: University Park is located directly adjacent to the college campus and features Crystal Pond, basketball courts, and walking trails.
cards.access_notes: Public city park open daily from dawn until dusk.

cards.title: Park Avenue
cards.subtitle: Park Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Dine at this local staple for Italian-inspired American fare located just a short walk from the university's west side.
cards.short_summary: A casual American grille and tavern on Park Avenue known for its diverse menu and proximity to Clark.
cards.evidence_claim: Peppercorn's is located on Park Avenue near Clark University and Downtown Worcester.
cards.source_title: Peppercorns Grille & Tavern | Worcester MA Restaurant
cards.access_notes: Open daily for lunch and dinner; reservations are available but not required.

cards.title: Beaver Street
cards.subtitle: Athletic Corridor
cards.notes: Head to the field house for indoor practice space and views of the turf fields from the outdoor deck.
cards.short_summary: A multi-use athletic facility on Beaver Street supporting Clark's varsity teams and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Thomas M. and Joan E. Dolan Field House is located at 97 Beaver St. and includes indoor practice space and a lounge area.
cards.source_title: The Thomas M. and Joan E. Dolan Field House - Facilities
cards.access_notes: Primarily for student-athletes and university community; check athletic schedules for event access.

cards.title: Woodland Street
cards.subtitle: Historic Residential Block
cards.notes: Walk past this historic Victorian home, which serves as the official residence for the Clark University President.
cards.short_summary: The Francis A. Harrington House is a historic Victorian residence on Woodland Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Francis A. Harrington House, home to the Clark president, is located on Woodland Street in a historic area.
cards.access_notes: Private residence; viewable from the public sidewalk on Woodland Street.

cards.title: Maywood Street
cards.subtitle: Campus Gateway
cards.notes: Start your campus journey at the Bassett Admissions Center, located in a converted Victorian house on Maywood.
cards.short_summary: The primary entry point for prospective students, located at the corner of Maywood and Main.
cards.evidence_claim: The Undergraduate Admissions Office is located at 1 Maywood Street.
cards.source_title: Our campus and location - Clark University
cards.access_notes: Open during standard business hours for prospective students and visitors.

cards.title: Downing Street
cards.subtitle: Campus Pedestrian Plaza
cards.notes: Access the campus pool, gym, and racquetball courts at this central athletic hub on Downing Street.
cards.short_summary: Clark's main athletic facility featuring a swimming pool, gymnasium, and fitness center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kneller Athletic Center is located on Downing Street and houses the university's main athletic facilities.
cards.source_title: Campus Map - Places AZ - Clark University
cards.access_notes: Open to students with ID; visitor access may require a pass or event ticket.

cards.title: Charlotte Street
cards.subtitle: Off-Campus Residential Block
cards.notes: Explore this residential street popular with upperclassmen for its proximity to the university's academic buildings.
cards.short_summary: A key residential street in the Main South neighborhood frequently used for off-campus student housing.
cards.evidence_claim: Charlotte Street is listed as a nearby street for off-campus housing options for Clark students.
cards.source_title: Off-Campus Housing | Residential Life and Housing
cards.access_notes: Public residential street; residential access is private.

cards.title: Hawthorne Street
cards.subtitle: Arts and Culture Block
cards.notes: Visit the Schiltkamp Gallery or attend a film screening at this dedicated arts facility on Hawthorne Street.
cards.short_summary: The home of Clark's Visual and Performing Arts department, featuring galleries and a cinema.
cards.evidence_claim: The Traina Center for the Arts is located at 92 Downing Street (with access from Hawthorne) and houses the Schiltkamp Gallery.
cards.access_notes: Galleries are typically open to the public during exhibition hours.

cards.title: Hermon Street
cards.subtitle: Industrial Revitalization Block
cards.notes: See the adaptive reuse of Worcester's industrial past in these loft-style apartments just blocks from campus.
cards.short_summary: A modern residential development in a restored factory building catering to the Clark community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Reeds is located on Hermon Street and offers student-friendly living minutes from Clark University.
cards.source_title: Student Apartments Near Clark University - The Reeds
cards.access_notes: Private residential building; exterior and leasing office accessible to visitors.
